claims.claim: Preserved existing projection, marker, ledger, confinement, replay, credentials, permissions and workflow configuration. Added no retry, polling or sleep; Work conformance remains a separate gate.

A frozen post-write transition permits exactly the pre-write or returned commit PR SHA while requiring the branch ref and marker confirmation to use the returned commit. Selected local scenarios completed EMITTED with one marker commit for lagging and converged PR heads.
Post-write checks reject third SHAs, identity substitution, branch ref disagreement and marker mismatch, and reacquire PR identity and the pinned branch ref immediately before EMITTED.
Pre-write validation retains exact PR/ref equality. Interrupted-write recovery requires exact convergence and completes the same ledger without another marker commit.

Added regressions reproducing run 36806928682 attempt 1's read-after-write failure shape using its marker commit and ledger IDs with fixture source selectors, plus adversarial third-SHA and post-write branch-movement cases.
